title: 茶水间英文 - 10月20日 | AI募资大战、抗癌药降价、世界大赛对阵
description:
OpenAI is rushing to raise thirty billion dollars before Anthropic's IPO, in an A I funding arms race for trillion dollar valuations. Alex and Jordan also cover India's plan to cut cancer drug prices by up to seventy percent, and the World Series matchup between the Rays and the Brewers, which guarantees a first time champion.

OpenAI 赶在 Anthropic 上市前紧急融资三百亿美元，AI 军备赛直指万亿美元估值。两人还聊了印度把抗癌药价格最高砍掉七成的民生好消息，以及世界大赛光芒对酿酒人、注定诞生新王的对阵。

Words to steal 生词本：
- pennant — 联盟冠军(旗)；季后赛冠军
- clinch — 锁定（胜局、冠军）
- underdog — 不被看好的一方；弱旅
- first-time champion — 首次夺冠(者)
- valuation — 估值
- lock in — 锁定（资金、机会）
- trade margin — 流通加价；中间环节利润
- cap — 设上限；封顶
